item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Tehran Appears to Cast Doubt on a Deal as Trump Makes New Threats
Trump presses Iran to agree to a peace plan, as Tehran casts doubt on progress in talks.
In Talks With Iran, China Calls for Opening of Strait of Hormuz
item.description: China’s top diplomat also warned against the restarting of hostilities as he met with Iran’s foreign minister. The U.S. has urged China to pressure Iran to reopen the waterway.
